info.title: PriceTruth API
info.summary: All-in price analysis, tracked history, accounts, alerts, billing, and B2B access.
info.description: Money is integer USD cents. Public browser APIs are unversioned and evolve with the web app. Contracted B2B APIs are under /api/v1. Mutations document their actual x-idempotency strategy; PriceTruth does not accept a generic Idempotency-Key header unless an operation explicitly says so.

x-idempotency.strategy: server-generated delivery key plus per-address rate limit

post.description: Alias of POST /api/auth/request. New clients should use the canonical route.

x-idempotency.strategy: server-generated delivery key plus per-address rate limit

post.summary: Consume a magic token and establish a browser session
post.description: Requires application/json and a same-origin browser request. Origin/fetch-metadata checks run before token consumption, so a rejected login-CSRF attempt does not burn the link.

x-idempotency.strategy: blocked while billing is active/pending; otherwise one account-deletion transaction
unique account and product; collection job uses time-bucket key
delete by unique account and product

signed alert token sets terminal alert state
none; each accepted call creates a new secret

post.summary: Atomically replace and revoke an API key

x-idempotency.strategy: none; retry may rotate the newly-created key again, so persist the first response

post.summary: Search verified sources and analyze; fails closed when no verified price is available

x-idempotency.strategy: anonymous calls do not persist; signed-in private product ids are deterministic within the owning account

post.description: Retired with HTTP 410 in production. Sign in and use /api/account/alerts so alert ownership, quotas, suppression, and deletion are account-bound.

post.summary: Create or reuse an account-owned Stripe Checkout session
post.description: Live mode requires cookie authentication, CSRF, acceptTerms=true, and acceptedTermsVersion exactly matching /api/meta legal.termsVersion. The versioned acceptance is recorded before Stripe session creation. Existing or pending API subscriptions must be managed in the portal rather than opening a second subscription.

x-idempotency.strategy: durable per-account/plan intent plus Stripe Idempotency-Key; local mock mode also accepts email-only compatibility calls

get.description: Returns HTTP 202 while the signed webhook has not fulfilled the session. Local mock mode permits an anonymous lookup.

post.summary: Claim a purchased API key exactly once

x-idempotency.strategy: claim-once transaction; HTTP 202 while fulfillment is pending
claim-once transaction; disabled outside local mock mode
Stripe portal session creation; local mock mode permits compatibility email input

post.description: The raw request body is verified. Unmapped critical live events are durably reconciled and return a retryable 503.
Bounces and complaints suppress the account notification channel. Duplicate provider events return 200.

x-idempotency.strategy: persistent svix-id or provider event ID deduplication
none; operator must store the once-shown response

post.summary: Append an operator-authorized canonical price observation
post.description: Canonical public-history ingestion requires an operator-issued API key with can_write_history scope. Ordinary customer API keys are read/analyze-only and receive 403, preventing tenant data from poisoning shared public history.

x-idempotency.strategy: none; operator ingestion clients should deduplicate upstream observation IDs

Read API usage (this request is metered)

cookieAuth.name: pt_session
cookieAuth.description: Opaque, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax session token. Only its SHA-256 hash is stored.

csrfHeader.name: X-CSRF-Token
csrfHeader.description: Required with cookie-authenticated mutations; must match the pt_csrf cookie and same-origin check.

RequestId.description: Server-generated or validated caller correlation id.

RateLimitReset.description: Seconds until the bucket is full.

DailyLimitRemaining.description: Requests left in the current UTC quota day.

Cents.description: USD cents; never a floating-point dollar amount.

truePrice.description: Evidence-backed total when completeness.status is complete; otherwise the known priced subtotal. Never interpret a partial report as a guaranteed checkout total.

suspended.description: Temporarily unauthenticatable while payment is past due; may resume after payment succeeds.

email.description: Local mock compatibility only; live checkout uses the authenticated account.

acceptTerms.description: Must be true in live mode.

acceptedTermsVersion.description: Must exactly equal /api/meta legal.termsVersion in live mode.
